source.method: Opened each candidate coordinate in the in-app browser using https://lightpollutionmap.app/en/?lat={lat}&lng={lon}&zoom=11 and extracted the Location Details panel.
notes: Bortle and SQM values are point samples for the listed coordinates, not official venue measurements.
Coordinates marked manual approximate should be verified before production use.
